title: Monsoon and Landfall
author: Edmund Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Vasquez, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
